item.title: Reinforce constitutional position on marriage; Dowry Prohibition Officers: SC issues directions for concentrated effort to eradicate evil of dowry
item.description: “Eliminating dowry is not only a matter of enforcing the DPA 1961 but a constitutional imperative. It fulfils the Republic’s promise that every woman should enter marriage as an equal citizen and not as the bearer of an unjust financial burden”. The post Reinforce constitutional position on marriage; Dowry Prohibition Officers: SC issues directions for concentrated effort to eradicate evil of dowry appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Arbitral Tribunal does not have jurisdiction to lift corporate veil: Madras High Court modifies arbitral award
item.description: “Arbitrator went wrong in applying the doctrine of lifting the corporate veil/ determining another entity as the alter ego and fastening the liability on the petitioner.” The post Arbitral Tribunal does not have jurisdiction to lift corporate veil: Madras High Court modifies arbitral award appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: BCI Reforms Legal Education: Legislative and Plain Language Drafting Now Part of LL.B. Curriculum
item.description: BCI has notified the integration of Drafting of Legislation and Plain Language Drafting into Paper 21 under Schedule II, Part II(B) of the Rules of Legal Education, 2008 to enhance legal drafting skills. The post BCI Reforms Legal Education: Legislative and Plain Language Drafting Now Part of LL.B. Curriculum appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Punjab and Haryana High Court dismisses plea to quash FIR against lawyer accused of portraying Judicial Magistrate to overawe police officers
item.description: When the lawyer failed in allegedly threatening the police officers, he drove away from the spot against their instructions. The post Punjab and Haryana High Court dismisses plea to quash FIR against lawyer accused of portraying Judicial Magistrate to overawe police officers appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Supreme Court issues directions to Trial Courts for ensuring systematic presentation of evidence for efficient appreciation of record
item.description: The directions were issued with the aim to institutionalize a standardized format for cataloguing witnesses, documentary evidence, and material objects, in order to facilitate better comprehension and immediate reference for all stakeholders, including the Appellate Courts The post Supreme Court issues directions to Trial Courts for ensuring systematic presentation of evidence for efficient appreciation of record appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Does the Issue of Reference to Larger Bench Require Reference to a Larger Bench?
item.description: by Abhishek Gupta* and Kumar Kartikeya** The post Does the Issue of Reference to Larger Bench Require Reference to a Larger Bench? appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: CAPF Examination Rule mandating strict cut-off period for issuance of OBC-NCL certificate declared invalid: Delhi HC
item.description: “To cancel the candidature of otherwise eligible candidates, on sole grounds of issuance date, deprives the petitioners of their fundamental rights under Articles 14 and 16 of the Constitution of India and actually runs contrary to the object sought to be achieved by providing reservations in public employment” The post CAPF Examination Rule mandating strict cut-off period for issuance of OBC-NCL certificate declared invalid: Delhi HC appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Right to privacy of students protected: Orissa High Court directs inclusion of refusal clause in APAAR ID Scheme
item.description: “If it is intended to be a voluntary act, appropriate provisions clearly specifying such fact ought to have been incorporated in the form by providing option to the parents to refuse to submit their consent or to opt out of it entirely.” The post Right to privacy of students protected: Orissa High Court directs inclusion of refusal clause in APAAR ID Scheme appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Know Thy Judge | Supreme Court of India: Justice Manmohan’s versatile legal career and important decisions
item.description: Justice Manmohan, formerly serving Chief Justice of Delhi High Court, was appointed as Judge of the Supreme Court of India on 3-12-2024. The post Know Thy Judge | Supreme Court of India: Justice Manmohan’s versatile legal career and important decisions appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Separate Suit challenging auction sale by Transferee Pendente Lite not maintainable: Supreme Court
item.description: “A transferee pendente lite takes the property subject to the outcome of the proceedings, irrespective of notice or bona fides.” The post Separate Suit challenging auction sale by Transferee Pendente Lite not maintainable: Supreme Court appeared first on SCC Times.
